annotations.title: Medicaid and CHIP income limits for a state

description: A state's Medicaid, CHIP and Basic Health Program income limits as a percent of the poverty line and in 2026 dollars per month and per year for a household size, by group (adults, parents, pregnancy, children by age, CHIP). With an income, also says which limits it is under. A screen of published limits, not an eligibility decision.

annual_income.description: Optional household income per year, to compare with each limit.

household_size.description: People in the household, usually everyone on the tax return. A pregnant woman counts as two or more.

state.description: Two-letter state code (e.g. TX, CA, DC) or full state name.
